# Load Data and Libraries

```{r}

# Libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Data
main <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/2026 CMSAC RRC/full_data.csv")

```

# Bounds Calculation

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(gganimate)

# =============================================================================
# 0. CONFIG 
# =============================================================================

INPUT_PHASE_VALUES  <- c("pre_pass")   # frames the model can "see", ending at throw
OUTPUT_PHASE_VALUES <- c("post_pass")  # frames after the ball leaves the QB's hand

VALID_PASS_RESULTS <- c("C")
FRAME_RATE_HZ <- 10  # standard NGS rate; 10 fps

# Define the search grid upfront so bounds checks can use it
frames_ahead_grid <- seq(5, 30, by = 5) 

# =============================================================================
# 1. Per-play throw frame, anchor point, QB release point, and landing spot
# =============================================================================

# Auto-detect column names for frame and position
frame_col <- intersect(c("frame_id", "frameId", "frame"), names(main))[1]
pos_col   <- intersect(c("player_position", "position", "officialPosition"), names(main))[1]

# Guarantee correct phase order
main$phase <- factor(main$phase, levels = c("pre_pass", "post_pass"))

# Create a continuous global_frame column that doesn't reset per phase
main <- main %>%
  arrange(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, phase, .data[[frame_col]]) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  mutate(global_frame = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Extract QB location at throw frame using global_frame
qb_throw_locs <- main %>%
  filter(
    (player_role == "Passer" | .data[[pos_col]] == "QB"),
    phase %in% INPUT_PHASE_VALUES
  ) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id) %>%
  slice_max(global_frame, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(game_id, play_id, qb_x = x_std, qb_y = y_std)

# Append qb_x and qb_y to throw_frames
throw_frames <- main %>%
  filter(
    player_role == "Targeted Receiver",
    phase %in% INPUT_PHASE_VALUES,
    pass_result %in% VALID_PASS_RESULTS,
    play_nullified_by_penalty == "N"
  ) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  slice_max(global_frame, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  inner_join(qb_throw_locs, by = c("game_id", "play_id")) %>%
  transmute(
    game_id, play_id, nfl_id,
    throw_frame = global_frame,
    anchor_x = x_std, anchor_y = y_std,
    qb_x, qb_y,
    ball_land_x_std, ball_land_y_std
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ball_land_x_std), !is.na(ball_land_y_std)) %>%
  mutate(
    pass_length = sqrt((ball_land_x_std - qb_x)^2 + (ball_land_y_std - qb_y)^2),
    pass_depth_bin = cut(
      pass_length, 
      breaks = c(-Inf, 10, 20, 30, Inf),
      labels = c("Short (<10 yds)", "Medium (10-20 yds)", "Deep (20-30 yds)", "Bomb (30+ yds)")
    )
  )

# Filter usable plays and extract maximum frame per play
play_max_frames <- main %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  summarise(max_avail_frame = max(global_frame), .groups = "drop")

# Extract the receiver's coordinates at the exact final frame of the play
receiver_final_locs <- main %>%
  inner_join(
    play_max_frames, 
    by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id", "global_frame" = "max_avail_frame")
  ) %>%
  select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, rec_final_x = x_std, rec_final_y = y_std)

# Apply filters for both lookahead frames and physical catch distance
throw_frames <- throw_frames %>%
  inner_join(play_max_frames, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")) %>%
  inner_join(receiver_final_locs, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Distance between receiver at final frame and ball landing spot
    catch_reach_dist = sqrt((rec_final_x - ball_land_x_std)^2 + (rec_final_y - ball_land_y_std)^2)
  ) %>%
  # Filter 1: Drop broken plays / tracking errors (> 15 yards away)
  filter(catch_reach_dist <= 15) %>%
  # Filter 2: Ensure sufficient post-throw tracking frames exist
  filter(max_avail_frame >= throw_frame + min(frames_ahead_grid)) %>%
  # Clean up temporary columns
  select(-max_avail_frame, -rec_final_x, -rec_final_y, -catch_reach_dist)

cat("Plays with sufficient frames and valid catch distances:", nrow(throw_frames), "\n")

# =============================================================================
# 2. Target receiver's FULL path & Geometry Builder
# =============================================================================

full_route_path <- main %>%
  select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, global_frame, x_std, y_std) %>%
  inner_join(
    throw_frames %>% select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, throw_frame),
    by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")
  ) %>%
  arrange(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, global_frame) %>%
  distinct(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, global_frame, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  mutate(frames_since_throw = global_frame - throw_frame) %>%
  ungroup()

build_path_geometry <- function(n) {

  path_pts <- full_route_path %>%
    filter(frames_since_throw >= 0 & frames_since_throw <= n) %>%
    arrange(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, global_frame) %>%
    group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
    summarise(
      px = list(x_std), py = list(y_std), 
      frames = list(global_frame), .groups = "drop"
    )

  df <- throw_frames %>%
    inner_join(path_pts, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id"))

  pmap_dfr(df, function(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, throw_frame,
                        anchor_x, anchor_y,
                        ball_land_x_std, ball_land_y_std,
                        px, py, frames, ...) {

    path_x <- unlist(px)
    path_y <- unlist(py)
    f_ids  <- unlist(frames)
    
    if (length(path_x) < 2) return(NULL) 

    dx <- diff(path_x); dy <- diff(path_y)
    seg_len <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)
    cum_len <- c(0, cumsum(seg_len))[seq_along(seg_len)] 

    bx <- ball_land_x_std; by <- ball_land_y_std

    vx <- bx - path_x[-length(path_x)]
    vy <- by - path_y[-length(path_y)]
    denom <- dx^2 + dy^2
    t <- pmin(pmax(ifelse(denom > 0, (vx * dx + vy * dy) / denom, 0), 0), 1)
    
    proj_x <- path_x[-length(path_x)] + t * dx
    proj_y <- path_y[-length(path_y)] + t * dy
    dist <- sqrt((bx - proj_x)^2 + (by - proj_y)^2)
    arc_at_proj <- cum_len + t * seg_len
    best <- which.min(dist)

    throw_idx <- which(f_ids >= throw_frame)[1]
    if (is.na(throw_idx) || throw_idx > length(dx)) throw_idx <- length(dx)
    
    ux <- dx[throw_idx] / (seg_len[throw_idx] + 1e-6)
    uy <- dy[throw_idx] / (seg_len[throw_idx] + 1e-6)
    
    vx0 <- bx - anchor_x; vy0 <- by - anchor_y
    back_along <- -(vx0 * ux + vy0 * uy)
    back_perp  <- sqrt(pmax(vx0^2 + vy0^2 - back_along^2, 0))

    tibble(
      game_id, play_id, nfl_id,
      min_dist = dist[best], arc_along = arc_at_proj[best],
      total_len = sum(seg_len),
      back_along = back_along, back_perp = back_perp
    )
  })
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. Stratified Envelope Evaluation
# =============================================================================

evaluate_bw <- function(geom, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead) {
  # Bring in the depth bins
  geom <- geom %>%
    inner_join(throw_frames %>% select(game_id, play_id, nfl_id, pass_depth_bin), 
               by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id")) %>%
    mutate(
      in_forward_tube  = min_dist <= corridor_width & 
                         arc_along >= 0 & arc_along <= total_len,
      in_backward_zone = back_along >= 0 & back_along <= backward_cushion & 
                         back_perp <= corridor_width,
      inside = in_forward_tube | in_backward_zone
    )

  # Group by class to equalize evaluation
  geom %>%
    group_by(pass_depth_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      backward_cushion = backward_cushion,
      corridor_width = corridor_width,
      frames_ahead = frames_ahead,
      coverage = mean(inside),
      mean_path_length = mean(total_len),
      area = (mean(total_len) + backward_cushion) * 2 * corridor_width,
      n_plays = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# =============================================================================
# 4 & 5. Grid search and Working Point Calibration (Stratified)
# =============================================================================

geom_by_n <- setNames(purrr::map(frames_ahead_grid, build_path_geometry), frames_ahead_grid)

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  backward_cushion = seq(0, 4, by = 0.5),
  corridor_width   = seq(1, 8, by = 0.5),
  frames_ahead     = frames_ahead_grid
)

results <- pmap_dfr(param_grid, function(backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead) {
  geom <- geom_by_n[[as.character(frames_ahead)]]
  evaluate_bw(geom, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead)
})

target_coverage <- 0.95

# Get the optimal parameters FOR EACH depth bin independently
best_per_bin <- results %>% 
  filter(coverage >= target_coverage) %>% 
  group_by(pass_depth_bin) %>% 
  arrange(area) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

cat("\n=== STRATIFIED OPTIMAL PARAMETERS ===\n")
print(best_per_bin %>% select(pass_depth_bin, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead, coverage, area))
cat("=====================================\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# 6. Robustness Check (Dynamic Evaluation)
# =============================================================================

# Combine geometries for all used frame lookaheads
all_geoms <- bind_rows(lapply(names(geom_by_n), function(f_ahead) {
  geom_by_n[[f_ahead]] %>% mutate(frames_ahead = as.numeric(f_ahead))
}))

# Join the optimal parameters to each play based on its depth bin, 
# then filter down to the geometry that matches that bin's optimal frames_ahead.
play_results <- throw_frames %>%
  inner_join(best_per_bin, by = "pass_depth_bin") %>%
  inner_join(all_geoms, by = c("game_id", "play_id", "nfl_id", "frames_ahead")) %>%
  mutate(
    in_forward_tube  = min_dist <= corridor_width & arc_along >= 0 & arc_along <= total_len,
    in_backward_zone = back_along >= 0 & back_along <= backward_cushion & back_perp <= corridor_width,
    inside = in_forward_tube | in_backward_zone
  )

coverage_by_depth <- play_results %>%
  group_by(pass_depth_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    total_plays = n(),
    opt_width = mean(corridor_width),
    opt_cushion = mean(backward_cushion),
    coverage_pct = mean(inside),
    mean_area = mean(area),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(coverage_by_depth)

# Plotting update
plot_depth <- ggplot(coverage_by_depth, aes(x = pass_depth_bin, y = coverage_pct, fill = pass_depth_bin)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(coverage_pct, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(play_results$inside), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  labs(
    title = "Class-Balanced Coverage by Pass Length",
    subtitle = "Parameters optimized independently per depth bin",
    x = "Pass Air Yards (Release to Landing)",
    y = "Coverage Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(plot_depth)

# =============================================================================
# 7. Play Animation with Dynamic Target Envelope
# =============================================================================

# Envelope builder function for animated frames
build_envelope <- function(player_path, t0_frame, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead) {
  route <- player_path %>%
    filter(global_frame >= t0_frame & global_frame <= t0_frame + frames_ahead) %>%
    arrange(global_frame)

  if (nrow(route) < 2) return(NULL)

  anchor <- route %>% filter(global_frame == t0_frame)
  if (nrow(anchor) == 0) return(NULL)

  path_x <- route$x_std
  path_y <- route$y_std

  dx <- diff(path_x); dy <- diff(path_y)
  seg_len <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)

  t0_idx <- 1
  if (seg_len[t0_idx] < 0.01) return(NULL) 

  list(
    path_x = path_x, path_y = path_y,
    dx = dx, dy = dy, seg_len = seg_len,
    anchor_x = anchor$x_std[1], anchor_y = anchor$y_std[1],
    init_ux = dx[t0_idx] / seg_len[t0_idx], 
    init_uy = dy[t0_idx] / seg_len[t0_idx],
    backward_cushion = backward_cushion,
    corridor_width = corridor_width
  )
}

# Pull the first valid play and its specific depth bin from the calibrated dataset
sample_play_info <- throw_frames %>% head(1)
sample_game   <- sample_play_info$game_id
sample_play   <- sample_play_info$play_id
sample_target <- sample_play_info$nfl_id
sample_bin    <- sample_play_info$pass_depth_bin

# Extract the optimal parameters for this specific play's bin
sample_params <- best_per_bin %>% filter(pass_depth_bin == sample_bin)
dyn_b <- sample_params$backward_cushion
dyn_w <- sample_params$corridor_width
dyn_f <- sample_params$frames_ahead

cat(sprintf("Animating play in bin: %s | Width: %.1f | Cushion: %.1f | Frames: %d\n", 
            sample_bin, dyn_w, dyn_b, dyn_f))

# Target receiver path deduplicated on global_frame
target_path <- main %>%
  filter(game_id == sample_game, play_id == sample_play, nfl_id == sample_target) %>%
  arrange(global_frame) %>%
  distinct(global_frame, .keep_all = TRUE)

# [Keep your get_frame_polygon function exactly as is here]

# Generate bounds across frames using the dynamic parameters
bounds_list <- purrr::map(target_path$global_frame, ~get_frame_polygon(target_path, .x, dyn_b, dyn_w, dyn_f))
bounds_list <- purrr::compact(bounds_list)

if(length(bounds_list) > 0) {
  bounds_frames <- do.call(rbind, bounds_list)

  animation_data <- target_path %>%
    inner_join(bounds_frames, by = "global_frame") %>%
    st_as_sf()

  bg_path <- target_path %>% 
    select(x_std, y_std, nfl_id) 

  anim <- ggplot() +
    geom_path(data = bg_path, aes(x = x_std, y = y_std, group = nfl_id), 
              color = "gray50", linetype = "dashed") +
    
    geom_sf(data = animation_data, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.2, color = "darkblue", size = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = animation_data, aes(x = x_std, y = y_std), color = "red", size = 4) +
    
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Target Receiver Envelope | %s | Frame: {frame_time}", sample_bin),
      subtitle = sprintf("Parameters: Cushion=%.1f, Width=%.1f, Frames Ahead=%d", dyn_b, dyn_w, dyn_f),
      x = "X Coordinate",
      y = "Y Coordinate"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    coord_sf(
      xlim = c(min(target_path$x_std) - 10, max(target_path$x_std) + 10),
      ylim = c(min(target_path$y_std) - 10, max(target_path$y_std) + 10)
    ) +
    transition_time(global_frame) +
    ease_aes('linear')

  my_anim <- animate(anim, nframes = nrow(animation_data), fps = FRAME_RATE_HZ, width = 800, height = 600, quiet = TRUE)
  my_anim
} else {
  cat("Notice: Animation skipped for sample play due to insufficient receiver movement.\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# 8. Residual Analysis & Spatial Diagnostic Plots (Stratified Update)
# =============================================================================

if (!requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)

# Sort by pass_length so the step-function in Panel A draws cleanly left-to-right
residual_data <- play_results %>%
  arrange(pass_length) %>%
  mutate(
    perp_residual = min_dist,
    long_residual = arc_along - total_len,
    linear_fit_res = lm(perp_residual ~ pass_length, data = .)$residuals
  )

# Panel A: Lateral Distance Residuals vs Pass Air Yards 
# FIX: Use geom_step to show the changing corridor width per depth bin
p_res_vs_depth <- ggplot(residual_data, aes(x = pass_length, y = perp_residual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_step(aes(y = corridor_width), color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "darkblue", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Lateral Route Residuals vs. Pass Air Yards",
    subtitle = "Dashed line = Dynamic Corridor Width per pass depth bin",
    x = "Pass Air Yards (QB Release to Landing Spot)",
    y = "Perpendicular Residual (Yards)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Panel B: Distribution & Density of Lateral Path Errors
# FIX: Map vertical threshold lines from best_per_bin
p_res_density <- ggplot(residual_data, aes(x = perp_residual)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 35, fill = "slategray", alpha = 0.6, color = "white") +
  geom_density(color = "darkblue", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = best_per_bin, aes(xintercept = corridor_width, color = pass_depth_bin), 
             linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Distribution of Lateral Path Residuals",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines = Optimal widths for respective depth bins",
    x = "Perpendicular Error (Yards)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Panel C: Q-Q Plot of Fitted Model Residuals
p_qq <- ggplot(residual_data, aes(sample = linear_fit_res)) +
  stat_qq(color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_qq_line(color = "firebrick", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "C. Normal Q-Q Plot of Model Residuals",
    subtitle = "Checks heavy-tail behavior in off-target passes",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Panel D: Longitudinal Depth Residuals 
p_long_res <- ggplot(residual_data, aes(x = pass_length, y = long_residual, color = inside)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "seagreen3", "FALSE" = "red"),
    name = "Inside Envelope"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "D. Longitudinal Residuals (Arc Landing vs Route Length)",
    subtitle = "Positive = Ball landed past route cutoff | Negative = Landed within route",
    x = "Pass Air Yards",
    y = "Longitudinal Residual (Yards)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Combine panels into 2x2 grid
# FIX: Update annotation to reflect dynamic parameters
residual_diagnostics <- (p_res_vs_depth | p_res_density) / (p_qq | p_long_res) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Target Envelope Residual Analysis Diagnostics (Stratified)",
    subtitle = "Envelope width, backward cushion, and lookahead frames optimized independently per depth bin."
  )

print(residual_diagnostics)
```

# Code for Other File

```{r}

library(dplyr)

# 1. Load the pre-calibrated parameters
optimal_params <- readRDS("optimal_envelope_parameters.rds") %>%
  select(pass_depth_bin, backward_cushion, corridor_width, frames_ahead)

# 2. Calculate receiver route depth on your new tracking dataset
route_depths <- new_tracking_data %>%
  # Filter down to the players you want to evaluate (e.g., all eligible receivers)
  filter(player_role %in% c("Targeted Receiver", "Receiver")) %>%
  group_by(game_id, play_id, nfl_id) %>%
  summarise(
    # Get receiver X coordinate at the first frame (snap)
    start_x = x_std[global_frame == min(global_frame)],
    # Get receiver X coordinate at the final recorded frame of their route
    end_x = x_std[global_frame == max(global_frame)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate vertical distance covered. abs() handles bidirectional play if not standardized,
    # but assumes x_std is your longitudinal coordinate.
    route_depth_yds = abs(end_x - start_x),
    
    # Map the depth to the exact same factor levels used in your calibration
    pass_depth_bin = cut(
      route_depth_yds, 
      breaks = c(-Inf, 10, 20, 30, Inf),
      labels = c("Short (<10 yds)", "Medium (10-20 yds)", "Deep (20-30 yds)", "Bomb (30+ yds)")
    )
  )

# 3. Join the optimal parameters to the evaluated routes
ready_for_pitch_control <- route_depths %>%
  left_join(optimal_params, by = "pass_depth_bin")

```
